name: Cluttercore

influenced_by: a reaction to 2010s minimalism/Marie Kondo decluttering culture

garments: not a fashion look — an interior-design aesthetic: dense layering of patterned textiles, collected objects, mismatched color
reacts_against: minimalist decluttering culture (explicitly including the Marie Kondo-driven 'does it spark joy' movement), arguing that density and personal history make a space feel alive.

wiki_facts.key_motifs: Curated collections, sentimental objects, gallery walls, overflowing bookshelves, plants, eclectic decor, layered textiles
wiki_facts.key_colours: Any, but often highly saturated and varied
wiki_facts.key_values: Authenticity, creativity, individuality, nostalgia, comfort, storytelling

findings: dark — about 51% of the measured color across 6 wiki images is below mid-lightness
mostly muted — about 60% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
measured.caveat: Colors measured from Aesthetics Wiki photos as photographed and displayed on screen; actual garments and materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
